## What changed

Describe the problem and the focused change that solves it.

## Validation

- [ ] `./scripts/test-host.sh` passes
- [ ] VitaSDK build passes, or the PR explains why it was not run
- [ ] Physical Vita behavior is documented when runtime code changed
- [ ] Dependency revisions remain pinned and license notices are current

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No private key, peer configuration, pairing certificate, VPK, console
      dump, personal endpoint, or unsanitized log is included
- [ ] New logs avoid exposing secrets or operational infrastructure

## Vita test details

If applicable, include the model, profile, and sanitized result. Do not include
real keys, certificates, or public endpoints.
